text_block_list.name: Commentary
text_block_list.text:
Following victories in the Satsuki Sho and the Japanese Derby,
the one who conquered the Kikuka Sho is Mejiro Ryan!!

text_block_list.name: Commentary
text_block_list.text: The promising hope of the Mejiro family has brilliantly clinched the Triple Crown—!!

text_block_list.name: Narrator
text_block_list.text:
Mejiro Ryan became a Triple Crown Umamusume.
Her goal of shining in the Classic races
had finally come true.

text_block_list.name: Mejiro Ryan
text_block_list.text: *Inhale*, *exhale*...

text_block_list.name: Mejiro Ryan
text_block_list.text: ...Whewww......

text_block_list.name: Mejiro Ryan
text_block_list.text: No... honestly, not at all yet.

text_block_list.name: Mejiro Ryan
text_block_list.text:
My body feels kind of floaty,
or maybe it just hasn't really sunk in yet...

text_block_list.name: Mejiro Ryan
text_block_list.text:
"I mean, to think that I actually beat
THE Mejiro McQueen."

text_block_list.name: Mejiro Ryan
text_block_list.text:
No, that's not all.
Racing against Ines too, it was truly, truly—

text_block_list.name: Mejiro Ryan
text_block_list.text: —You were able to become a Triple Crown Umamusume, weren't you?

text_block_list.name: Mejiro Ryan
text_block_list.text:
It feels like a dream.
The sights from just moments ago, the cheers, all of it.

text_block_list.name: Mejiro Ryan
text_block_list.text:
Of course, the Classics have always
been my goal.

text_block_list.name: Mejiro Ryan
text_block_list.text:
...Still, each time, I was just desperately focused on the race right in front of me.
Pushing myself recklessly, without any room to breathe.

text_block_list.name: Mejiro Ryan
text_block_list.text:
"So, even during today's Kikuka Sho,
I totally forgot that the Triple Crown was on the line."

text_block_list.name: Mejiro Ryan
text_block_list.text: (Still... today's single win has become something truly precious to me.)

text_block_list.name: Mejiro Ryan
text_block_list.text: (Because I feel like I managed to show you a dependable back, if only just a little.)

text_block_list.name: Mejiro Ryan
text_block_list.text:
—Right now, it feels as though
my mind has finally caught up with my body.

text_block_list.name: Mejiro Ryan
text_block_list.text: Yes, bit by bit.

text_block_list.name: Mejiro Ryan
text_block_list.text: ...Though having said that, I still have a long way to go, and plenty of challenges ahead...!

text_block_list.name: Mejiro Ryan
text_block_list.text: I was hoping that if I work even harder from now on, I could grow stronger and greater—

text_block_list.name: Ines Fujin
text_block_list.text:
That's right,
Ryan-chan should have a lot more confidence in herself!

text_block_list.name: Mejiro Ryan
text_block_list.text: Ines...?

text_block_list.name: Ines Fujin
text_block_list.text:
"Geez, what is the star of the show doing all the way out here?
You're going to be late for the party!"

text_block_list.name: Mejiro Ryan
text_block_list.text: A party? For what?

text_block_list.name: Ines Fujin
text_block_list.text:
"Come on~, obviously that's
to celebrate Ryan-chan's Triple Crown!"

text_block_list.name: Mejiro Ryan
text_block_list.text: Wait, really...?!

text_block_list.name: Mejiro Ryan
text_block_list.text: —Yes!!

text_block_list.name: Mejiro Ryan
text_block_list.text:
(Running and running... I still can't see
what lies beyond, but even so—)

text_block_list.name: Mejiro Ryan
text_block_list.text:
(Someday, I'll definitely see it.
Right now, I can believe that...!)

text_block_list.name: Narrator
text_block_list.text:
A fresh wind blows through—
toward the future, toward dreams yet unseen.
